name: lag_1
justification: Persistence is a strong AMR baseline; last observed resistance anchors forecasts.

name: lag_2
justification: Two-year history helps detect acceleration beyond single-year noise.

name: delta_1
justification: Recent momentum complements level for rising-resistance detection.

name: roll_mean_2
definition: Mean of resistance in last two observed years before t.
justification: Smooths single-year sampling noise in surveillance counts.

name: roll_std_2
definition: Std dev of last two years before t.
justification: Volatile series may need different alert thresholds in review.

name: hist_max
justification: Historical peaks indicate prior selection pressure in the population.

name: hist_min
justification: Floor resistance contextualizes how far a series has already risen.

name: years_observed
definition: Count of years with data strictly before t.
justification: Maturity of surveillance series affects forecast reliability.

name: has_lag2
justification: Flags when two-year dynamics features are defined.

name: log_tested
justification: Larger denominators stabilize proportion estimates in surveillance.

name: ast_coverage
definition: GLASS AST coverage at t-1 row.
justification: Incomplete testing can bias apparent resistance levels.

name: wilson_width
definition: 95% Wilson interval width from t-1 counts.
justification: Quantifies uncertainty in the lagged resistance estimate.

name: n_ge_30_prev
justification: WHO-style minimum denominators for reliable proportions.

name: class_mean_other
definition: Mean resistance of other drugs same ATC class at t-1.
justification: Class-level co-resistance is common in Gram-negative surveillance.

name: other_mean_all
definition: Mean resistance of all other antibiotics at t-1.
justification: Background multidrug resistance signals ecosystem pressure.

name: n_high_other
definition: Count of other antibiotics with resistance >= T at t-1.
justification: Counts co-resistant drugs relevant to multidrug phenotypes.

name: mdr_burden
definition: n_high_other divided by number of other antibiotics observed.
justification: Normalizes multidrug burden to comparable scale across pathogens.

name: pathogen
justification: Species drives intrinsic resistance mechanisms and trends.

name: antibiotic
justification: Drug-specific epidemiology varies by mechanism and usage.

name: antibiotic_class
justification: Groups agents with related resistance pathways.

name: who_region
justification: Regional policies and circulation patterns differ globally.

name: region_median_prev
definition: Median resistance for pathogen x antibiotic across countries at t-1 within source.
justification: Peer benchmark for whether a country is an outlier.

name: gap_from_region_prev
justification: Relative elevation may persist or mean-revert differently.

name: covid_flag
justification: Pandemic years disrupted sampling and hospital mix.

name: is_glass
justification: Lets pooled models respect source-specific measurement.

name: ecdc_definition_ipr
justification: Captures systematic definition difference in pooled training.
